_status: Module 4, Try it 4.3 'Triage the inbox' and its model answers (learner guide of 21 October 2026, pages 10, 17 and 18), word for word.

options.label: File it or let it go

items.text: A vendor advisory says the RSSO's VPN product has a security update for a weakness listed in CISA's KEV catalog.

facts.v: Yes: attackers are already using this weakness, so update now
Ana; Director Eva approves any downtime

items.text: A news article on global ransomware trends this year.

facts.v: Director Eva, in the monthly bulletin

items.text: An alert, marked TLP:AMBER, says two RSSO staff email addresses appear in a newly reported breach.

facts.v: Yes: reset both passwords and check MFA and sign-in history
AMBER: within the office, on a need-to-know basis; not the all-staff chat

items.text: A partner office shares a list of mobile numbers used by scammers posing as the RSSO, marked TLP:GREEN.

facts.v: Yes: warn the staff who answer calls and texts
GREEN: staff and partner offices, not the public. To warn citizens, ask the sender's permission or write your own warning without the list

items.text: A forwarded chain message, with no source, says "Delete this app now or your phone will be hacked."

facts.v: No: no source, nothing to verify
Do not pass it on; ask IT if unsure

items.text: A joint advisory asks government offices to give their head a readiness assessment within 24 hours.

facts.v: Ana prepares; Director Eva receives and decides
